integrity: The deterministic finite-copy criterion is an antecedent reconstructed for completeness, not asserted new. Numerical consistency checks are not an infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for equally spaced passive full-rank diagonal qutrits. Uniform ordered-simplex law, and bounded continuous probability densities positive along an interior part of the Gibbs curve. No unequal-gap or coherent-state claim.
title: Pareto-tail copy activation for randomly sampled passive qutrits
